candidates.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the supplied generated Flanvel Tower stone texture. Keep the exact canvas dimensions/aspect, composition, all surrounding dark teal stonework, circular rim, diagonal spokes and partial neighboring medallions unchanged.
Change ONLY the inside face of the large central circular medallion: remove every checker, maze, lattice and other gray or green marking completely. Replace it with one blank pale-mint stone face, gentle diffuse illumination, faint stone grain, brighter toward the center and duller near its rim. Preserve its circular outline and rim. No pattern or engraving inside the face at all. This blank face will receive the exact original native lattice via authorized Python repair afterward.
Constraints: no new objects, no letters, no runes, no symbols, no extra cracks or ornament, no watermark, no margin, fully opaque texture.

Primary request: restore this dark teal-green carved stone architecture with a mint luminous central round medallion, as restrained detailed hand-painted fantasy RPG environment art. Keep exactly the central pale round medallion centered at x=32/64,y=24/56, diameter about32/64 of image width. No fluorescent neon, no metallic redesign. Output one opaque texture covering the full canvas; do not add transparent margins.
